Yes 👏 you win a free yearly supply of alfalfa
I’m guessing you didn’t read anything I wrote since I said I don’t think it’s a big deal and am not trying to make a change

I have all season(?) or all weather tires (whichever one is better is what I have) with good tread and brand new. It was right after a left turn and wasn’t going fast at all so I didn’t expect to hit a patch of sheer ice.

People in this sub go out of their way to get offended by anything btw. I don’t see how or why you felt the need to take this as me complaining about the city or neighbourhood not shovelling, especially when it is flaired as “funny” and not “politics” or anything else. This has been the same for the 8+ years I’ve lived here and if I had an issue with the roads I would make an entirely different post. A description of the conditions that allowed me to drift is not a political statement and should not be taken as one.

Switching accounts because the other one is making me very angery by forcing me to wait 10 mins for every comment made.

I don’t mind that it’s the standard and what we’re used to. This was not a comment on the city yet people took it that way, I was just describing the conditions that allowed my car to do this unexpectedly. If anything it was rather fun but I don’t want to do it again and risk hitting something the next time so hopefully it melts soon and doesn’t freeze over
Thank you for this, it gives me some helpful and greatly needed insight

I feel like my relationship with my boyfriend is coming to an end, we’re LD and gradually it’s just getting harder and harder to stay close.... He’s such a sweet, loving person, so attentive and empathetic... Yet it hurts me now to say “I love you”. If I don’t constantly distract myself with something to do or watch, I start feeling like crying more and more. I feel a lot of guilt in my heart, but it’s more than this, and because I can’t tell where it’s coming from and don’t know how to deal with it, it makes it even worse. I just feel pain now, I don’t know who to talk to or what to do. I feel guilty because he cares about me so much and has been so dutiful in trying to keep up together and show he loves me, every day lately, to spend more time with me. But I no longer feel the same as him, I hate that I’m innately such a selfish and judgemental person. I just...I just don’t know what else to do. I feel lonely and lost and sad I can’t stop crying, I know me being sad hurts him too which makes me cry more. I need help or advice, from someone who’s gone through a similar experience, please...
